Specification: This specification is a model-checking wrapper module for a system defined in Session10, adding termination, type-correctness, recursive path, and distance properties. It models a rooted graph or tree-like structure with node depths, parent pointers, and message queues, and specifies that once all queues are empty, the parent relation should define paths whose lengths match graph distance to the root. The module verifies termination as an eventuality, enforces a type invariant over state variables and message contents, and states a correctness condition asserting that termination implies the postcondition relating parent paths to graph distance.
IfThenElse: IF i = 1 THEN TRUE ELSE msgs[q][i-1] > msgs[q][i]
IF n = root THEN <<n>> ELSE <<n>> \o PPath(parent[n])
IF n \in S THEN 0 ELSE 1 + DistanceFrom(n, S \cup SetNbrs(S))
